statuses.unavailable: empty functions and edges with unavailable rank meaning

ranking: functions sorted descending cumtime, then file/line/function
path_policy: <runtime>|<agent>|<stdlib>|<package> relative paths; no absolute or parent traversal
arithmetic_policy: counts are nonnegative integers; times are finite nonnegative numbers; cumtime >= tottime
timing_note: cProfile overhead inflates absolute times; use ranking and call counts observationally, never as the original budget
